title: Agentic Slides launches free AI presentation tool with #AgenticSlides #AItools #presentations
description: Agentic Slides launched with Nano Banana Pro, offering an advanced, free presentation tool combining live data charts and AI-generated visuals. It features two modes: Adaptive mode delivers McKinsey-style slides with real-time data integration from sources like Yahoo Finance and the IMF, while Visual mode provides designer-quality images with unlimited AI-generated content. This workflow enhances productivity by allowing full editing and instant chart updates, supporting exports to PPT, Google Slides, or PNG formats. It represents a significant shift in presentation tools by merging rich data tracking with creative design capabilities, all accessible without cost.
